annotations.text:
The panel on the left is live — pick a theme or flip a control and the shell beside it repaints.

Values are lifted from the real app: 20px cards on a white-to-#fdfcf9 gradient, rgba(28,28,26,0.08) hairlines, the --bf-app type ramp, 56px rail.

Every number on the right was measured against the surface the colour actually sits on.

That is what moved four of the five palettes off their first draft — the notes under each row say which, and why.
